The '''Yerej system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Tungra sector/Legends|Tungra sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the planet [[Yerej]].<ref name="XwVsTie" />

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the system was the host to the [[Drekker Industries]] Special Materials Factory ''[[Drekker]]'', an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Deep Space Manufacturing Facility]]. It came under attack by a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Nebulon-B escort frigate]], the ''[[Meteor (frigate)|Meteor]]'', and its squadrons of [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]].<ref name="XwVsTie" />
